title: Signing in
summary: Get your password link, sign in, and find the demo and the guide.

shots.title: Email
shots.text: Type the email address the program has for you.

shots.title: Password
shots.text: Type your password. Passwords are stored only as scrambled hashes.

shots.title: Sign in
shots.text: Opens your pathway. Five wrong tries lock the email for 15 minutes.

shots.title: First time here, or forgot your password?
shots.text: Click this the first time you sign in, or whenever you forget your password.

shots.title: Email me a link
shots.text: Type your email and click Email me a link. The link works once and lasts 24 hours.

shots.title: Set your password
shots.text: The link opens this page. Choose 10+ characters with a letter and a number, type it twice, and click Set password and sign in.

shots.title: Explore the demo
shots.text: Choose mentor/coach, board president, superintendent, or site administrator. All public demo views use sample people and are view only.

shots.title: Choose a role
shots.text: View as a mentor/coach, board president, superintendent, or site administrator. Board president is a sample preview, not a live login.

shots.title: How-to guide
shots.text: Step-by-step help with pictures, even before you sign in.

title: Getting around
summary: Tabs, Back, Help, your password, and signing out.

shots.title: Tabs
shots.text: Switch between My Pathway, Calendar, Course Catalog, Phases, Badges, Hours, Evaluation, and Standards Alignment.

shots.title: My Pathway
shots.text: Where you are, what is coming up, your phases, badges, hours, and evaluation.

shots.title: Calendar
shots.text: Sessions, coaching, assignments due, and offerings you can enroll in, by month.

shots.title: Course Catalog
shots.text: Sign up for workshops and events, and choose your strand or academy.

shots.title: Back
shots.text: Goes back one screen, for example from the calendar to your pathway.

shots.title: Help
shots.text: Opens the how-to guide, with pictures and Show me buttons.

shots.title: Change password
shots.text: The key button changes your password.

shots.title: Sign out
shots.text: Ends your session on this device.

title: Your pathway
summary: Where you are, what is next, and how phases work.

shots.title: Where you are
shots.text: Your phase (Onboarding, Year 1, Year 2, or Year 3), your coach, and your mentor.

shots.title: Leadership pipeline
shots.text: Your total hours, phases completed, and what is left for the current phase badge.

shots.title: Coming up
shots.text: Your next sessions, coaching calls, and assignments due. Click one to open the class.

shots.title: The four phases
shots.text: Each phase earns a badge. Click a phase to see its events.

shots.title: Phase details
shots.text: Required events, your strand or academy, and the hours you have toward the badge.

shots.title: Class titles
shots.text: Click any class title to open its class page.

title: Using the calendar
summary: See every session, coaching call, and due date by month.

shots.title: Change months
shots.text: Use ‹ and › to move between months, and Today to come back.

shots.title: Colors
shots.text: Sessions, coaching, assignments due, offerings you can still enroll in, and completed classes.

shots.title: An item
shots.text: Click any item to open that class.

shots.title: The month
shots.text: Today is circled. Dates marked as samples are filled in for the demo.

title: Inside a class
summary: When it meets, how to join, materials, and the assignment.

shots.title: When and where
shots.text: The date and time, how it meets, who leads it, and your status.

shots.title: Join the session
shots.text: The join link appears here once your coach posts it.

shots.title: Your progress
shots.text: Mark the session complete here after it meets, or ask for a substitution.

shots.title: Materials
shots.text: Handouts and pre-reading. Click View or Open.

shots.title: Assignment
shots.text: What to turn in, and when it is due.

shots.title: Back
shots.text: Returns to where you were.

title: Mark complete and turn in work
summary: Finish a session, turn in the assignment, and read your coach’s feedback.

shots.title: Mark complete
shots.text: After the session, click Mark complete.

shots.title: Date and reflection
shots.text: Choose the date and write a short reflection. A program administrator confirms it, then it counts.

shots.title: Turn in your work
shots.text: Write about your work, add a link if you have one, and click Turn in.

shots.title: Coach feedback
shots.text: Your coach’s feedback appears under your work.

title: Enrolling in courses
summary: Use the Course Catalog to sign up for workshops and events.

shots.title: Browse & enroll
shots.text: Opens the Course Catalog (so does the Course Catalog tab).

shots.title: My enrollments
shots.text: Everything you have signed up for.

shots.title: An offering
shots.text: Date, format, hours, and the DESE standard it is aligned to.

shots.title: Enroll
shots.text: Signs you up. It goes on your Coming up list and calendar.

shots.title: Enrolled
shots.text: Click Drop if your plans change.

title: Hours, badges, and your evaluation
summary: Log hours, request a substitution, and use your badges with your board.

shots.title: Log hours
shots.text: Log coaching, mentoring, conferences, and other learning. An administrator approves them.

shots.title: Hours form
shots.text: Pick the category, hours, date, and phase, add a note, and click Log hours.

shots.title: Request substitution
shots.text: Count equivalent learning (prior experience, district training) in place of an event.

shots.title: Badges
shots.text: Phase and Competency Series badges, and the MASA/TQC Pathway Certificate when all four phases are done.

shots.title: Evaluation
shots.text: Choose MSBA, MARE, your district’s own tool, or standards only.

shots.title: Print report
shots.text: Prints the Standards Alignment Report to bring to your board.

title: For coaches and mentors
summary: See your people, log hours for them, and give feedback.

shots.title: Your roster
shots.text: You see only the superintendents assigned to you.

shots.title: Pick a person
shots.text: Switch between the people you coach or mentor.

shots.title: Log hours for them
shots.text: Mentors log Mentoring hours only. Hours wait for an administrator’s approval.

shots.title: Give feedback
shots.text: Open a class and write feedback under the work they turned in.

title: Administrators: roster and approvals
summary: Approve work, record attendance, and add superintendents.

shots.title: At a glance
shots.text: How many superintendents are in each phase.

shots.title: Waiting for approval
shots.text: Sessions marked complete, hours logged, and substitution requests.

shots.title: Approve or Decline
shots.text: Approved items count toward badges right away. A decline asks for a short reason.

shots.title: Search
shots.text: Find someone by name or district. Click View to open their pathway.

shots.title: Superintendent View
shots.text: See exactly what that superintendent sees.

shots.title: Record attendance
shots.text: Give credit for a session to everyone who attended, at once.

shots.title: Attendance
shots.text: Pick the session and date, check who attended, and click Save attendance.

shots.title: Add superintendent
shots.text: Adds them to the roster and emails a link to set a password.

title: Administrators: people and sign-in
summary: Add people, send sign-in links, change roles, and turn accounts off.

shots.title: Add a person
shots.text: For coaches, mentors, MASA staff, and program staff.

shots.title: Email link
shots.text: Emails a one-time link to set a password.

shots.title: Copy link
shots.text: Makes a link you can send yourself.

shots.title: Role
shots.text: Member sees what the roster connects them to; Admin sees everything.

shots.title: Status and last sign-in
shots.text: Who can sign in, whose link is waiting, and when each person last signed in.
